name: mcp-data-ops
description: Postgres tuning (EXPLAIN, index advice, health, restricted mode) and Grafana (Prometheus, Loki, dashboards, alerts).

postgres_uri.title: Postgres connection URI
postgres_uri.description: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db. Use a read-only role. Leave empty if unused.

grafana_url.title: Grafana URL
grafana_url.description: e.g. http://localhost:3000 or https://you.grafana.net. Leave empty if unused.

grafana_token.title: Grafana service account token
grafana_token.description: Grafana > Administration > Service accounts > Add token (Viewer role is enough).
